## Original request

issue store works as a term. i suggest let's implement it for files/git, dynamo and postgres with shared tests. add the store choice wherever we choose a destination branch, require it at issue creation, and support project and folder defaults.we can default to files/git for now. keep asking questions and dont implement yet. also i am wondering if we should separate any internal state from issue storage, for example claims. if we were to use jira for example we would want the claims to be stored elsewhere

<!-- prettier-ignore-end -->

## Agreed design

The discussion selected separate Issue, Coordination, and Artifact roles, shared
execution history and evidence, cross-runner idle execution, source checkpoints,
remote Stop, manual recovery, outage behavior, checked migrations, same-store
groups, shared archives, and periodic progress. The complete decisions and
acceptance cases are in [the draft spec](../docs/plans/issue-stores.md).
[ADR 0022](../docs/adr/0022-separate-issue-coordination-and-artifact-stores.md)
records the architecture.

## Current status

Planning only. The user explicitly paused implementation. Keep this report idle
with autonomy ask. Do not start workers, connect to provisioned stores, create
resources, move records, or change defaults from these discussion answers.

Reproduction does not apply to this new storage feature. No application change,
prototype, provider integration check, or migration has been performed. Existing
Git behavior remains the runtime behavior.

The user supplied the setting names FACTORY_ARTIFACTS_BUCKET,
FACTORY_ISSUES_DB_URL, FACTORY_DB_USER, and FACTORY_DB_PASSWORD. No secret values
were read and no connectivity was verified. Physical schemas, DynamoDB keys,
interface signatures, and provisioning templates still need design review.

The separate Settings issue 20261121T193206044-bdfc66cebc522e64 intentionally
supports existing providers only. This proposal does not expand its scope.

## Next action

Review the draft spec and provisioning plan. Keep implementation paused until
explicitly authorized. Preserve the existing claim and human acceptance rules.

## Planning verification

The draft specification, terminology, navigation, and architecture decision were
saved in documentation-only commit 39c2767. Formatting, local link checks, and
the strict staged audit passed. The feature remains unimplemented and idle.
No infrastructure, store contents, or defaults were changed.

Documentation check evidence is retained in
`.issues/evidence/issue-store-design/checks.json`.

## Database isolation clarification

Factory must use a dedicated database, such as timey_issues_db when the installed
application uses timey_db. Sharing a Postgres server or instance is allowed.
Using the application's database through a different schema is forbidden.
Factory roles may share the dedicated Factory database. The draft spec and
ADR 0022 now record this requirement and its configuration validation case.
Implementation remains paused.

## Confirmed connection details

The user supplied FACTORY_ARTIFACTS_BUCKET_REGION=eu-central-1 and confirmed that
FACTORY_ISSUES_DB_URL targets a dedicated Factory database. The S3 implementation
must pass the bucket-specific region explicitly. These details have not been
verified through a live connection. Implementation remains paused.
